title: Adult Mouse Spleen Dissociation Protocol
author: Andrew Potter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ydwfs7e
materials: Isolate whole spleen and immerse/transport in ice-cold DPBS.

steps.title: Prepare spleen tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Using sterile forceps, transfer the adult mouse spleen to a petri dish on ice, remove excess DPBS with a pipette, and coarsely chop with a razor blade for 45 seconds on ice until a fine paste, continuously manipulating with forceps while mincing to thoroughly break up the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Transfer spleen to ice‑cold petri dish
Chop with razor blade for 45 s on ice

steps.title: Weigh and transfer minced spleen
steps.instruction: Weigh 12 mg of the minced spleen onto the petri dish, then using a razor blade transfer it into a 1.5 mL tube containing 1 mL enzyme mix kept on ice.

substeps.instruction: Transfer to 1.5 mL tube with 1 mL enzyme mix on ice

steps.title: First enzyme digestion incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 10 minutes, triturating the suspension 10 times every 2 minutes and shaking gently every 1 minute throughout the incubation.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and filter
steps.instruction: After the 10‑minute digestion, let tissue chunks settle on ice for 1 minute, collect approximately 80 % of the supernatant containing released cells, and apply it to a 30 µm filter placed in a 50 mL conical tube on ice; rinse the filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA, keeping the filter and conical on ice for later steps.

substeps.instruction: Settle tissue chunks 1 min on ice
Filter onto 30 µm filter in 50 mL conical
Rinse filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA

steps.title: Add second enzyme mix and digest
steps.instruction: Add an additional 1 mL enzyme mix to the remaining tissue chunks on ice, then incubate for a further 10 minutes while triturating 10 times every 2 minutes and shaking every 1 minute (total digestion time 21 minutes).

substeps.instruction: Incubate on ice 10 min with trituration and shaking

steps.title: Final filtration of digest
steps.instruction: After the total 21‑minute digestion, triturate the suspension 10 times, then add the entire remaining digest volume to the same 30 µm filter in the 50 mL conical tube; rinse the filter again with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA and collect the flow‑through.

substeps.instruction: Rinse filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA

steps.title: Centrifuge and reduce volume
steps.instruction: Transfer the flow‑through to a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 650 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C; after spin, remove the supernatant, leaving 100 µL of liquid in the tube.

steps.title: Red blood cell lysis
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL RBC lysis buffer to the 100 µL cell suspension, triturate 10 times, and incubate on ice for 3 minutes; then add 13 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA to dilute the lysis buffer and mix by pipetting.

substeps.instruction: Add 13 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA and mix

steps.title: Second centrifugation and resuspend
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 650 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 1 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA

steps.title: Count cells and adjust concentration
steps.instruction: Examine cells using a hemocytometer with trypan blue, and adjust the suspension to 1,000 cells/µL for 10× Chromium or 100 cells/µL for Drop‑Seq.
